verdict.rationale: Paychex's own developer API overview lists "Webhooks" as a documented topic next to its REST, OAuth 2.0, paging and rate-limiting sections, so a first-party webhook capability appears to exist. The pack shows only that table-of-contents entry, so how fully it works is unproven. Missing for 10: details of subscribable event types, a documented registration/subscription mechanism for callback URLs, payload format and signing/security, retry semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
